Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly mapped the ancient Maurya context to a modern country, concluding Ashoka (Tivala’s father) was “from Pakistan” by conflating Ashoka’s association with Taxila (in present-day Pakistan) with his origin. This premature synthesis contradicted its own note that the Maurya Empire corresponds largely to present-day India, lacked explicit source verification, and led to an erroneous final answer.
